capabilities: Convert typed '[ ]' plus space into a '- [ ]' checkbox at the start of a line
Work inside existing bullets, keeping the list marker
Leave brackets in the middle of a line untouched
extras: A beta channel is available by adding the repo via the BRAT plugin; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in shortcut for starting a task; you must type the full '- [ ]' Markdown syntax by hand.
summary: Typing shortcut that turns '[ ]' typed at the start of a line into a Markdown checkbox when you press space, like Notion's shortcut.
